policy.summary: ADWR Pinal_Parcels layer (statewide parcel extract subset). SITE_*/OWNER_NAME stripped. Preferred over Casa Grande MapServer (~60k incomplete). No clear CDN/commercial grant; class unknown.

workflow_clip.notes: Server-side clip/mask / point-in-polygon during automation. Default deny until written terms allow commercial processing.
